subject: NexusMed Week0 orchestration — scheduling, roles, and ops floorplan
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nexusmed.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.m@nexusmed.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nexusmed.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Week0 orchestration — kickoff scheduling and ops floorplan

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re ready to lock in a Week0 kickoff to get NexusMed’s integration started — primary goals are SSO + data-routing validation, initial latency checks, and the production handoff plan.

NexusMed attendees (high level):
- Samantha Lee — Program Lead
- Daniel Park — CTO (technical owner)
- Priya Malhotra — Product Manager (owner: success criteria)
- IT alias (it@nexusmed.com) — VPN/infra contact

Can you propose 2–3 60–90 minute windows next week (US/Eastern preferred) that include a platform walkthrough, host responsibilities, and verification steps? Also please share a short agenda and any prework (credentials, test data, IP allowlist) we should prepare.

I attached a quick team roster for reference.

Thanks,
Samantha
Program Lead | NexusMed
S: +1-617-555-0117

[Attachment: Nexus_Onboarding_Team.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nexusmed.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Week0 orchestration — kickoff scheduling and ops floorplan

Hi Samantha — great to meet you over email. Welcome — excited to get NexusMed set up.

Proposed 60–75 minute windows (all shown with Eastern / Redwood PST):
- Thu Aug 26 — 11:00–12:15 ET (08:00–09:15 PT)
- Fri Aug 27 — 14:00–15:15 ET (11:00–12:15 PT)
- Mon Aug 30 — 10:00–11:15 ET (07:00–08:15 PT)

Draft agenda (short):
1) Intros & success criteria (10 min)
2) Architecture & data flow review (15 min)
3) Platform walkthrough: onboarding flow, SSO, dev/test endpoints (20–25 min)
4) Staging verification checklist and roles (15 min)
5) Next steps & owner assignments (5–10 min)

Prework we need from NexusMed:
- SSO IdP metadata (SAML/OIDC) or test user credentials
- One sample dataset (anonymized) and expected routing rules
- IP ranges to allow for test bridge

I’ll attach a concise Week0 agenda and a one-page attendee roster to the invite. Jordan will lead the platform demo; Olga will cover SSO and networking requirements; Priyom will take notes and capture the action log.

If one of those slots works, reply with the preferred option and any extra folks to add. Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite with the bridge link and the agenda attached.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0123

[Attachment: Week0_Agenda.pdf]
From: jordan_blake@redwood.com <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-22T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Week0 orchestration — kickoff scheduling and ops floorplan

Thanks Mateo — I’ll own the platform walkthrough and an abbreviated demo focused on:
- endpoint mapping and auth flows (10 min)
- live token exchange / sample request (8–10 min)
- KV cache and latency expectations for NexusMed’s payloads (5 min)

If NexusMed has a specific sample request shape (JSON example) please paste it into a reply — I can include it in the demo.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

Samantha
